records.reason: The text does not require coaxiality, circular lateral contact, or the largest sphere. A fully contained counterexample has r=sqrt(17), frustum height2r, sphere center(1,0,r), and section radius18-8z/r. At z=r*(1+u), its farthest radial coordinate is1+r*sqrt(1-u^2). Containment is equivalent to r*sqrt(1-u^2)+8u<=9, which follows from Cauchy with r^2+64=81. Equality at u=8/9 gives genuine interior lateral tangency. Top and bottom contacts both have radial coordinate1, inside both disks. This differs from the valid coaxial radius6, so the missing condition is material. Preserve sourceA and the intended axial-geometry interpretation separately.
